What the agent made, and files for it
Lets your nanoMuse tap, type and swipe in apps when you ask it to

With this on, your nanoMuse can look at the screen and act in apps on your behalf — only during a task you gave it, with a Stop button on screen the whole time. It reads the screen to find buttons and fields, performs taps and swipes, and takes screenshots for the model you configured; nothing goes anywhere else. It never types passwords or codes and stops before paying, sending or deleting. Off by default; you can turn it off here any time.
